Dmitri: quick heads-up: saw a spike in model regressions after enabling quantized kernel selector on Dedicated. Mostly Mistral and Qwen runs. Perf shows KV prefetch drop + fallback to small-batch kernel. Repro and logs below. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Carla: confirming — eval harness failing on long-context Llama-ish prompts, weird token shifts. Rolling back quant-toggle fixed QA on our side.
Eli: I pulled a profile. Kernel selector prefers int8-tiled kernel for batch sizes <=4. But our batching heuristic started producing smaller micro-batches due to recent latency SLO change. That made KV warmup worse.
Dmitri: can you paste profiler snippets?
Eli: ```
perf-bench: kernel_selector -> selected_kernel=int8_tiled
batch_size=2 kv_cache_miss_rate=0.73 avg_latency_ms=42
fallback_kernel=float32_contig kv_fill_time_ms=95
```
Alice: interesting — also see RoPE scaling tweak in the last commit (rope_scale=1.03) for Qwen. That can shift attention weights when quantized.
Frank: we've got eval diffs showing higher perplexity + 2% QA NDCG drop on mixtral long-chat tests.
Dmitri: ops plan: rollback the kernel selector flag for production, add a higher micro-batch threshold, and disable rope_scale change in canary. Thoughts?
Carla: agree. Also add perf test that simulates high tail latency and small batching to catch selector flips.
perf-bot: Perf alert: nightly-evals failed (regression >1.5%) on qwen-longchat, ticket #INC-4821 created.
oncall-bot: Deploy rollback scheduled at 12:15 UTC by @Dmitri. Will post status.
Dmitri: rolled back and monitoring — initial signals look sane. follow-ups: (1) add kv prefetch warmup in runtime, (2) change selector to prefer fp fallback if kv_miss_rate>0.5, (3) create canary that runs quant kernel only when microbatch_size>=8.
Eli: I'll open PRs for selector and warmup. Also propose adding a 'rope-sensitivity' eval in the regression suite to capture these interactions.
Carla: :thumbsup: set remediation ticket and assign owners? I can take warmup and tests.
Dmitri: thanks. logging follow-up in INC-4821 and perf PR refs in the ticket. closing thread once follow-ups merged.
